title: HostFactory getReturnRequests response
$comment: Pins what hf-gce emits today. Spec: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/spectrum-symphony/7.3.2?topic=specification-getreturnrequests. Differences from the spec are noted inline. The spec example has a top-level 'status' that hf-gce does not emit.

requests.$comment: The spec shows a single object. hf-gce emits an array.
